rules: $return-only kernels are the dominant failure mode this round: 7 of 8 cheap_screen rejects and both crossover_not_a_fusion rejects trace to $return alone (via TS_RANK, TS_MEAN-diff, TS_DECAY_LINEAR, TS_CORR-vs-own-lag, TS_STD-ratio, SIGN-then-sum, or as a crossover donor) — including every return+fundamental CS_ZSCORE fusion tried (leverage, roe, roa, book_per_share). Both accepts, including the top score (fitness 7.646), used price-level/dollar_volume kernels with no $return; prefer those, especially as the non-fundamental leg of a fundamental fusion.

SIGN($return) bucketed and summed over 21 days scored |t| = 0.00 exactly. Avoid sign-discretizing a continuous return/price field before TS_SUM/TS_MEAN aggregation — it can erase the signal completely.

$volume and $dollar_volume behaved as near-duplicate inputs inside a short-window TS_CORR kernel (rho 0.994). Don't propose both as separate candidates in the same shape; pick one, or use their ratio if price-weighting is the actual intent.

TS_STD($dollar_volume, 21) tracked TS_MEAN($dollar_volume, 21) at rho 0.933 — raw dispersion scales with raw level across this cap range. Normalize dispersion by level (std/mean) before proposing a dollar_volume 'variability' factor.

RANK($roa * $asset_turnover) still hit rho 0.907 against RANK($roa) alone — multiplying two DuPont-related fundamentals doesn't decorrelate from either. Treat roa/roe/operating_margin/asset_turnover as one correlated cluster; vary the non-fundamental side of the expression instead.

archive_subtree caught more than window edits this round: swapping one OHLC field (open for close) in an otherwise-identical ratio, swapping one fundamental leaf in a two-term rank spread, and wrapping an archived payload in LN() all still shared most of the parent's nodes. Change an inner operator or structure, not a single field/fundamental/wrapper.

A 63-day range ratio survived a denominator swap and an added vol-scaling term but still hit rho 0.916 against the archived version (TS_MEAN($high/$low,63)/TS_STD($return,63) vs TS_MEAN(($high-$low)/$open,63)). Changing which price anchors a range ratio isn't enough to decorrelate it — change the window or the core comparison.

Both crossover_not_a_fusion rejects this round donated only ABS($return) (2 nodes) from a TS_CORR(ABS($return), $volume, 21)-shaped parent, short of the minimum. Donate a larger structural chunk of that parent, not just the ABS($return) leaf.
